text:
sophie: Heads up — BrightData just asked for a per-endpoint throughput add-on that supports rollover credits and per-route caps. They want the option in the contract and in the Console UI. Can we decide scope before EOW?

matt: Got it. Is this a paid add-on or part of a higher tier?

sophie: They want it as an add-on (pay-as-you-go) with an optional monthly cap and unused-credit rollover to next month. Also need SLO for peak bursts.

eva: Tech constraints: per-endpoint throughput limits are doable but we need routing policy changes and per-account quota bookkeeping. Rollover means we need monthly ledger + prorated adjustments for mid-month plan changes.

raj: Pricing perspective: two paths — (A) simple fixed throughput bucket with X credits/month + rollover, or (B) tokenized burst credits billed per-use with a small monthly reservation. Path A simpler for customers, B optimizes cost.

matt: For launch criteria, we should require: 1) Console UI to create add-on and view rollover balance, 2) Billing integration and invoice line item, 3) SLA text for throughput & fallback routing, 4) e2e tests for quota enforcement. Agree?

sophie: Agree. Also legal sign-off on contract language and a short migration plan (for customers switching plans).

legal: Example clause draft to start with:

```
Throughput Add-on: Customer may purchase a Throughput Add-on which provides a monthly pool of Throughput Credits. Unused credits will roll over to the following billing period up to a maximum carryover equal to 50% of the newly purchased monthly pool. Credits are tied to the Customer account and may be applied to any endpoint. Redwood Inference will enforce per-endpoint caps as configured in the Console.
```

legal: We'll need to confirm carryover cap and whether credits are transferrable between subaccounts.

raj: For revenue modeling, I suggest a mid-point price of $0.35 per 1k throughput-credits with a $500/mo reservation for the managed rollover bucket. We can run sensitivity on churn impact.

billing-bot: BrightData current ARR: $280k. Estimated incremental monthly add-on revenue at 10% adoption: ~$2.8k. Billing integration tasks: create invoice line item code `THRU_ADDON`, support proration.

eva: One more ops note — for failover we should add automatic fallback to a lower-cost compatible model when the add-on bucket is exhausted (to avoid hard failures). That ties into routing policy work.

matt: Good catch. Add fallback policy to launch checklist. Also need metrics: per-endpoint TPS, bucket consumption rate, rollover used.

sophie: Next steps: 
- raj to finalize pricing ranges and run revenue sim (by Thu)
- legal to draft contract language (initial by Fri)
- eva to estimate implementation ETA + docs (ETA in 2 weeks?)
- matt to own launch checklist and e2e test plan

sophie: I'll coordinate a 30m sync Thu AM to close decisions. @raj @legal @eva please bring blockers. :thumbsup:

matt: I'll add the checklist to the roadmap doc and flag for PM review.

sophie: Thanks — moving this to product backlog as `throughput-rollover-addon` and assigning owners.

raj: +1. I'll include alternative pricing models in the sim (fixed vs tokenized).

legal: Will send first draft before EOD Fri.

billing-bot: Task created: BILL-1128 - implement THRU_ADDON invoice line item (assignee: billing).
